- **~10-15% broken cross-domain links** — mostly `../concepts/` vs `../terms/` mismatches and references to nonexistent files
- **8 stub domains** with _index.md but zero content (african philosophy, chinese philosophy, etc.)
- **12 empty terms/texts directories**
- Top cross-referenced term: `sign.md` (semiotics) — linked 157 times across 77 files
